base_ci: Corrected D17 Tests, Docker and active platform checks pass
ci: Reviewed head CI passed; correction-head CI is reported after push, not inferred from previous head.

review_fixes.R1: All creation paths allocate names across connected and detached descendants. Three mixed-path regressions fail before the fix and pass after save/reload.
review_fixes.R2: Promotion transfers authored coordinates to the new orphan root; root drag removes stale overrides. Promotion, movement, save/reload and Undo are verified.
review_fixes.R3: Sample dirty state compares JSON values, not formatting, and acknowledges late confirmed values without replacing newer text. Input/output remount and delayed-save regressions pass.
review_fixes.browser_scope: Real compact input/output save, node change, testing enabled; detached-child drag, parent deletion, root drag, acknowledged fixture save and Pebble reflow. No external mutations.
review_fixes.reverification: Full 8-layout browser matrix, 80 settled inspector cycles, 10 rapid keyboard cycles, 10 node inspectors, 390px and reduced motion rerun and passed after fixes.
